question_title: After a recent update to V156.0.1, Thunderbird insists that I am not correctly logged into my IP (Spectrum) for my charter email.
question_content: Repeated attempts to log in using the window presented continue to fail.  My password is correct and I am able to log in on the spectrum website without problems.  I have two email accounts in TB ;  one with Outlook.com and the other with Charter.net.  The Outlook account logs in without problem but the charter account continues to give me the message that the login failed (image attached).  When I go too the account server settings in TB for charter and do a test connection under security settings, a connection is made without a problem (image attached). I believe the previous version (156.0) was working but there seems to be a rapid succession of changes coming down the pike lately.  I have had intermittent problems of this nature in the past 4 or 5 months so it's difficult to keep track of which versions are successful. Help please.  I am not thrilled with spectrum but I do not want to change my email address.
